title: Acyclic incoming kernels and images by dimension shifting
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme, $V\subseteq Y$ an open, and $K^\bullet$ a cochain complex of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules concentrated in nonnegative degrees [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $H^r(V,M|_V)$ for module right-derived global sections on $V$ [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. Suppose $H^r(V,K^n|_V)=0$ and $H^r(V,\mathcal H^n(K)|_V)=0$ for all $n\geq 0$ and $r>0$. Let $f_p$ be the incoming map of the short complex computing degree-$p$ homology: $f_p=d^{p-1}$ for $p>0$ and $f_0=0:K^0\to K^0$. Then $H^r(V,(\ker f_p)|_V)=0$ and $H^r(V,(\operatorname{im} f_p)|_V)=0$ for all $p\geq0$ and $r>0$.

proof.text: Construct the short exact sequences $0\to B^n\to Z^n\to\mathcal H^n(K)\to0$ and $0\to Z^n\to K^n\to B^{n+1}\to0$, where $Z^n=\ker d^n$, $B^0=0$ and $B^{n+1}=\operatorname{im}d^n$. Use the kernel/cokernel universal properties and the epi-mono image factorization. Open restriction preserves both sequences: the proved source instance AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.preservesLimitsOfSize_restrictFunctor provides finite limits, and the restriction adjunction provides finite colimits.

Apply the full long exact sequence of module right-derived sections to the restricted sequences. Starting at $B^0=0$, induct on $n$: acyclicity of $B^n$ and $\mathcal H^n(K)$ makes $Z^n$ acyclic by exactness at its positive cohomology; acyclicity of $Z^n$ and $K^n$ makes $B^{n+1}$ acyclic by the exact piece $H^r(K^n)\to H^r(B^{n+1})\to H^{r+1}(Z^n)$ for $r>0$.

For $p>0$, identify the incoming kernel with $Z^{p-1}$ and image with $B^p$. For $p=0$, use the zero differential, whose kernel is $K^0$ and image is zero. Transport vanishing through the kernel and image isomorphisms and through the cohomology functor.

theorem section_acyclic_incoming_kernel_image
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (K : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℕ) (V : Y.Opens)
    (hterms : ∀ (n r : ℕ), 0 < r →
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology V.toScheme.toRingedSpace r).obj
        ((restrictFunctor V.ι).obj (K.X n))))
    (hhomology : ∀ (n r : ℕ), 0 < r →
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology V.toScheme.toRingedSpace r).obj
        ((restrictFunctor V.ι).obj (K.homology n)))) :
    ∀ (p r : ℕ), 0 < r →
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology V.toScheme.toRingedSpace r).obj
        ((restrictFunctor V.ι).obj (kernel (K.sc p).f))) ∧
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology V.toScheme.toRingedSpace r).obj
        ((restrictFunctor V.ι).obj (image (K.sc p).f)))
